statistical_choice.formula: z=Phi^-1(1-alpha/(2*12)); every row compared jointly to [y-z sigma,y+z sigma].
statistical_choice.scope: At least95percent simultaneous coverage CONDITIONAL on unbiased Gaussian random-error marginals with these sigma values. Union bound requires no independence or known correlations. Published error semantics do not establish this assumption; count it explicitly and test sensitivity. This rectangle is an observation acceptance region, not a posterior or calibrated parameter confidence set by itself.
statistical_choice.distinct_algebra_review: recovered_packet_audit verified the conditional Bonferroni construction and limitations in this session.
statistical_choice.systematics: Source, distance, inclination, pressure and estimator-transfer systematics are separate common nuisance terms. No unbounded independent per-row bias is profiled as a fit device; if an unbounded systematic cannot be constrained the corresponding calibration claim remains unidentified, not fabricated.

distance_summary.scope: Monotone transform of reported conditional68percent summary only; not hard physical support or a complete likelihood. Shared distance zero-point and extinction systematics retained.

forward_coordinates.radius: r_model=r_catalogue*(D/4.04Mpc); source angular geometry uses its own4.3Mpc reference, scaled once.
forward_coordinates.velocity: Compare to published deprojected circular-speed estimate. Do not apply sin(i) again to published data. If varying true inclination, forward-project material motion through the actual adopted estimator and its reference deprojection.
forward_coordinates.model: Current owned-parent source/stress plus common metric and material/observation operator; never SPARC Vgas/Vdisk/Vbul as native source/force.

parameter_freeze: No twelve-coordinate uncertainty region has been evaluated or frozen by this data operation. Joint shared-parameter/state/source/boundary inference follows the actual response provider. Preserve nonidentifiability and correlations. NGC3198 targets remain excluded.
